finding.expected: Make serialized AUDIT_RECONCILE decision revalidation fail closed for any Stage-2 semantic_value that cannot be proven to be the exact output of the reviewed BP-4A validator, including NO_DECISION. Preserve the exact AIOS_BRAIN_DECISION contract and BP-4A authority boundary: do not replace BP-4A with duplicated semantic logic. Add a focused adversarial regression showing that tampering NO_DECISION Stage-2 fingerprints or semantic material and recomputing decision_fingerprint is rejected.
finding.issue: revalidate_decision does not fully revalidate an AUDIT_RECONCILE NO_DECISION semantic_value against the reviewed BP-4A Stage-2 semantics. In the NO_DECISION branch it only checks closed fields, lineage-shaped values, lens grammar, closure/outcome consistency and that handoff_candidate is null. A caller can alter stage2_fingerprint and/or reconciled_candidate_fingerprint to arbitrary 64-hex values, recompute decision_fingerprint over the altered decision, and the serialized decision is accepted. The same path also cannot re-establish BP-4A reconciliation consistency because the reconciled candidate is absent from the exact Stage-2 result. Therefore a recomputed outer content hash can make unvalidated Stage-2 material appear to be a valid serialized Brain decision, contrary to AC7's requirement that mode-specific semantic_value be validated on serialized revalidation.
